summary: Prepare for the AWS Developer Associate Certification with our comprehensive training course. Gain essential skills and confidence to excel in your exam.
lede: AWS developer associate training helps cloud application developers and DevOps engineers build, deploy, and troubleshoot cloud-native applications. Learners practice creating Lambda-based serverless functions, designing DynamoDB data models, securing API Gateway endpoints, automating CI/CD workflows, and using CloudWatch and X-Ray to investigate application behavior, while preparing for the DVA-C02 exam.
audienceIntro: This comprehensive training is engineered for technical professionals responsible for designing, building, and maintaining cloud-native applications within the AWS ecosystem.
modules: AWS Cloud Architecture and IAM Fundamentals
Managed Database Solutions and Amazon DynamoDB
API Management with Amazon API Gateway
CI/CD Automation and AWS Developer Tools
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of at least one high-level programming language (such as Python, Node.js, or Java) and a basic understanding of core cloud computing concepts. Prior hands-on experience navigating the AWS Management Console is highly recommended.
